note: Human-reviewed, accepted cross-link collisions. Each entry here is reviewed once, pins the exact reviewed fargo_ids, and is excluded from the hard collision invariant (reported as `accepted_ambiguous`). The published crosswalk marks such keys `ambiguous` so PoolPredict disambiguates instead of trusting one id. A NEW id appearing on a listed key re-flags it as a real collision. See docs/cross-league-identity.md.
